headline: Clinton order adjusts certain federal pay rates and hands off one federal pay management power to another official.
what_it_does: This executive order changes certain rates of pay set by the federal government. It also delegates, or hands off, one authority related to managing federal pay to another official or agency. No summary was provided, so the specific pay rates, amounts, and who receives the delegated authority are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain federal pay rates are adjusted, which may change how much some workers are paid.
One pay administration authority is delegated, changing who is responsible for carrying it out.
